input: During the evening-shift interview the driver explains that road signs sometimes appear as two overlapping images after several hours, improving when either eye is covered, although this did not occur during the short consultation; he reports no diplopia at rest, and the nurse has not established the angle from central fixation or whether the symptom persists with the updated lenses.

A loose optometry slip lists right 6/12 and left 6/18 beside an earlier date and right 6/6 and left 6/9 beside a later date, but it does not identify which measurements were corrected; the driver describes a blurred patch off to one side, has no formal binocular field result, and has not supplied the specialist assessment.

The driver says he repeatedly misses a vehicle approaching from the left even though straight-ahead letters look sharp, and brings a binocular field printout labelled 140 degrees whose reliability flag is poor; no one has confirmed whether testing covered the required vertical extent, whether a central scotoma exists, or whether the apparent loss is stable rather than progressing.

He remembers being told his remaining useful eye saw 6/9 after an old injury, but another note mentions useful vision in both eyes and neither document accompanies today's interview; no conclusion about monocularity or a current field standard can be made from the recollection alone, and an optometrist appointment is booked rather than completed.

The driver attends with a current signed GP summary and a three-week measurement log; after reviewing repeated seated measurements, the GP documents that current persistent blood pressure is 178/106 mmHg.
During today's conversation the driver reports difficulty understanding dispatch when the engine is running, and hearing screening suggests possible hearing loss.
He brought an invoice for a hearing aid consultation rather than a completed test, and neither the better-ear average nor the required frequencies has been measured in the supplied record.
The nurse distinguishes the verified persistent pressure from those unresolved questions and from the separate hearing complaint.
